**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (rule structurally inapplicable).**

- **Term structure:** § 12.1 (p0485) fixes a single Term running from the Effective Date until expiry of Sanofi's payment obligations under Article IX or the Profit/Loss Share Agreement, subject only to early termination under Article XII. Those obligations are themselves bounded by the Royalty Term (p0395) and the Profit/Loss Share Agreement's own expiry (p0408).
- **No renewal mechanic:** searches for "automatically renew", "renew", "successive/additional term", "extend the Term", and "unless either Party gives written notice prior to expiration" returned no term-renewal language. The only "renewal" hits are patent continuations/renewals (p0098) and insurance non-renewal notice (p0603) — neither is a term renewal.
- **No renewal pricing:** no CPI or price-increase/uplift language exists, so no uplift cap is engaged.
- **Direction check:** the clause imposes no non-renewal notice window or lock-in on us; any extension would require the Parties' mutual agreement. Nothing here disadvantages Sanofi, so no redline was proposed (I did not call `lookup_precedent`/`propose_redline`, which apply only to actionable findings).

The conditional preferred and fallback elements (12-month renewal term, ≤30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, CPI/3% or 5% cap, ≤60-day non-renewal window) are all predicated on automatic renewal and are therefore untriggered.
